player_prompt.intro:
Udlala Blackjack nobe dealer.
Inhloso yakho kukhuluma enye kakhulu ku 21 ngaphandle kokwehlela ngaloko.
Ekuseni kwakho, khetha '[Hit]' ukuthatha ikhadi ngenye noma '[Stand]' ukubamba.
J/Q/K = 10 amapoyinti; A = 11 noma 1, lokhu lokuhamba kahle.
